verdict: ROAS held positive this period, but a clear weekly decline needs attention now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.69 for every $1.00 spent on $1,524.15 in ad spend, generating $5,617.53 in revenue across 36 purchases. However, the most recent week showed a 23% drop in return on ad spend and a 30% drop in purchases compared to the week before — a trend confirmed across the last several days, not a single off day. The primary driver is your top campaign reaching a narrower audience pool, with performance becoming inconsistent. Ad creative is being refreshed and audience strategy is being adjusted this week to reverse the decay before it compounds further. Several site and automation builds are also being completed now that will improve conversion tracking and give a cleaner picture of what's driving purchases going forward.
